DashboardSupport.title: A personal appeal
DashboardSupport.p1: We generally don't ask, but today we need your help. Genie AI is an independent project, built to provide you with the most advanced AI tools without the big corporate price tag.
DashboardSupport.p2: It takes a lot of resources to keep our servers running and to develop new innovative features. If everyone reading this gave a small amount, we could keep Genie AI thriving for years to come.
DashboardSupport.p3: If you find value in what we do, please consider supporting us. It only takes a minute, and it makes a huge difference.
